🧠 Crypto News Brief: A record $6.3B Binance hack, linked to North Korea, dragged Bitcoin below $78K and flipped sentiment to fear, while rapid fund freezes and Binance's pledge to cover all losses helped contain contagion. 🚨 Binance Hit by Record $6.3B Hack, North Korea Suspected Binance paused withdrawals after attackers drained its hot wallets in the largest crypto theft on record. The exchange traced the breach to a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop, while TRM Labs attributed the attack to an elite North Korean hacking unit. Read full story 🛡️ Binance Reserves $6.34B to Make Users Whole Binance says it has set aside more than $6.34B of company funds, about $5B already held in the affected tokens, and will cover all losses through SAFU and corporate reserves. Deposits run normally; withdrawals are expected back within roughly 48 hours. More details 🧊 Tether, Circle and Arbitrum Freeze Stolen Funds Around $3B of the stolen assets is now frozen on-chain. Tether and Circle locked stablecoins tied to the attacker, and Arbitrum's Security Council moved 74.56M ARB from the hacker's wallet into a frozen intermediary address. Read more 📉 Bitcoin Hits Six-Week Low as $1.5B in Bets Liquidated BTC slid to about $76,460 before rebounding toward $78,500 as the hack triggered $1.53B in forced liquidations, roughly $1.29B of them long positions. The Fear & Greed Index dropped to 30 from 51 a day earlier. See details 🏦 Strategy Posts Record $20.9B Q3 Operating Income Strategy reported $44.75 diluted EPS for Q3, driven by a $20.9B fair-value gain as Bitcoin rallied during the quarter. The company now holds 848,517 BTC and has raised $21.2B in capital year to date. Read full story 🇰🇷 South Korea Weighs Fourth Delay to Crypto Tax The ruling Democratic Party met heads of the country's five largest exchanges on Friday to discuss postponing the 22% crypto income tax due in January 2027, citing gaps in overseas trading data. A pending bill would push the start to 2029. More details ⚙️ Kraken Restores Trading After One-Hour Outage Kraken resolved connectivity and order-placement failures that hit spot and derivatives users across web, mobile and API between 02:42 and 03:42 UTC. The incident followed scheduled maintenance a day earlier, which Kraken did not link to the outage. Read more
